definitions.text_mt: L-isfera ta' gassijiet li n-nifs nieħdu minnha.

usage_examples.mt: L-arja kienet friska kmieni filgħodu fil-muntanji.
usage_examples.en: The air was fresh early in the morning in the mountains.

definitions.text_mt: Klassifikazzjoni jew oġġett li jikkorrispondi għal world.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kelma “dinja” dehret f'sentenza li tispjega world.
usage_examples.en: The word “dinja” appeared in a sentence illustrating world.

definitions.text_mt: Il-stilla li tagħti d-dawl u s-sħana fid-dinja.

usage_examples.mt: Ix-xemx kienet tiddi b'qawwa sħiħa fis-sajf.
usage_examples.en: The sun was shining brightly in summer.

definitions.text_mt: Il-bidu u l-ewwel mossa ta' azzjoni jew jum.

usage_examples.mt: Fl-bidu tal-jum kulħadd beda x-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: At the beginning of the day everyone started work.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' baħar fl-użu u t-tifsira uffiċjali.
Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' baħar fl-użu u t-tifsira uffiċjali.
Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' baħar fl-użu u t-tifsira uffiċjali.
Kors u fluss kbir ta' ilma li jgħaddi fl-art.

usage_examples.mt: Il-xmara kienet mimlija ilma wara x-xita.
usage_examples.en: The river was full of water after the rain.

definitions.text_mt: Oġġett, kwalità jew kunċett li jikkorrispondi għal wind.
Oġġett, kwalità jew kunċett li jikkorrispondi għal direction.

usage_examples.mt: L-użu ta' riħ kien prominenti u utli ħafna fil-ħajja.
usage_examples.en: The use of wind was prominent and very useful in life.

definitions.text_mt: Il-fjammi u l-ħaraq li joħroġ mis-sħana u l-fuklar.
Il-murtali u l-lampi li jaħarqu fil-festa tar-raħal.

usage_examples.mt: Xgħalu n-nar fil-fuklar biex jsaħħnu l-kamra.
usage_examples.en: They lit the fire in the hearth to warm the room.

definitions.text_mt: Il-korp ċelesti li jidderi fis-sema skura bil-lejl u jdur madwar l-art.

usage_examples.mt: Il-qamar kien kwil u jiddi fuq il-baħar kollu bil-lejl.
usage_examples.en: The moon was full and shining over the entire sea at night.

definitions.text_mt: Tifsira u deskrizzjoni ta' 'gżira': island.

usage_examples.mt: Gżira kien f'postu fil-bini u fl-użu ta' kuljum.
usage_examples.en: The gżira was in its proper place in daily use.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' borra fl-użu u t-tifsira uffiċjali.
Korp ċelesti imdawwal mis-sema li jidher matul il-lejl.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm preżenza ċara ta' stilla fit-tfassil tax-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: There was a clear presence of star in the design of the work.

definitions.text_mt: Massa kbira ħafna ta' ilma mielaħ li tissepara l-kontinenti.

usage_examples.mt: Il-vapur qsam l-oċean fit-tieni ġimgħa tal-vjaġġ.
usage_examples.en: The ship crossed the ocean in the second week of voyage.

definitions.text_mt: Ilma li jinżel mill-sħab fuq l-art.

usage_examples.mt: Ix-xita bdiet nieżla b'qawwa fit-triq.
usage_examples.en: The rain started falling heavily in the street.

etymology_chain.definition: Sound uttered by the mouth, especially by human beings in speech or song; sound thus uttered considered as possessing some special quality or character

definitions.text_mt: Ħoss u kapaċità li titkellem jew tkanta maħluqa mill-ħaluta.

usage_examples.mt: Kelli vuċi ħelwa u mimlija emozzjoni meta kantat.
usage_examples.en: She had a sweet voice filled with emotion when singing.

definitions.text_mt: Preċipitazzjoni ta' ilma ffriżat minħabba l-kesħa.
Ilma ffriżat solidu.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm ħafna silġ fuq it-toroq matul ix-xitwa u kien kiesaħ.
usage_examples.en: There was a lot of ice on the roads during winter and it was cold.

definitions.text_mt: Tnejn minn oġġett li jaqblu (bħal par żraben jien u int).

usage_examples.mt: Ixtra par żraben ġodda għat-tieġ tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: He bought a pair of new shoes for his wedding.

definitions.text_mt: Pajsaġġ kbir mimli b'bosta siġar u annimali selvaġġi.

usage_examples.mt: Mxejjen fil-foresta densa taħt id-dell tas-siġar.
usage_examples.en: They walked in the dense forest under the shade of the trees.

definitions.text_mt: Ftuħ b'ħġieġ fil-ħajt biex jidħol id-dawl u l-arja.

usage_examples.mt: Fetaħ it-tieqa biex tidħol l-arja friska tal-għodwa.
usage_examples.en: He opened the window to let in the fresh morning air.

definitions.text_mt: Sistema u vettura tal-ħadid użata fil-passat f'Malta għat-trasport.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ferrovija ta' Malta kienet tgħaqqad il-Belt mal-Rabat.
usage_examples.en: The Malta railway used to connect Valletta with Rabat.

definitions.text_mt: L-ispazju miftuħ 'il fuq mill-art fejn jinsab ix-xemx.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sema kienet ikkulurita bir-roża mal-estinzjoni tax-xemx.
usage_examples.en: The sky was colored pink with the sunset.

definitions.text_mt: Tifsira u deskrizzjoni ta' 'gass': gas (state of matter).
Tifsira u deskrizzjoni ta' 'gass': gas, wind, flatus.
Tifsira u deskrizzjoni ta' 'gass': accelerator.

usage_examples.mt: Gass kien f'postu fil-bini u fl-użu ta' kuljum.
usage_examples.en: The gass was in its proper place in daily use.

definitions.text_mt: Oġġett, kwalità jew kunċett li jikkorrispondi għal spring.

usage_examples.mt: L-użu ta' rebbiegħa kien prominenti u utli ħafna fil-ħajja.
usage_examples.en: The use of spring was prominent and very useful in life.

definitions.text_mt: Tifsira u deskrizzjoni ta' 'ġebel': stones.

usage_examples.mt: Ġebel kien f'postu fil-bini u fl-użu ta' kuljum.
usage_examples.en: The ġebel was in its proper place in daily use.

definitions.text_en: somewhat, fairly, rather (to a moderate degree)
definitions.text_mt: Mod jew stil li fih jiġi espress somewhat, fairly, rather.

usage_examples.mt: Uża l-espressjoni 'daqsxejn' b'mod xieraq fid-diskors.
usage_examples.en: Used the expression 'somewhat, fairly, rather' appropriately in speech.

definitions.text_mt: Partiċelli żgħar tal-blat jew tal-kosta tal-baħar.

usage_examples.mt: It-tfal lagħbu bir-ramel fuq ix-xatt ta' Għajn Tuffieħa.
usage_examples.en: The children played with the sand on Għajn Tuffieħa beach.

definitions.text_mt: Wieħed mill-erba' perjodi tat-sena (ir-rebbiegħa, is-sajf, il-ħarifa, ix-xitwa).

usage_examples.mt: Ir-rebbiegħa hija l-isbaħ istaġun tas-sena fejn jinfetħu l-fjuri.
usage_examples.en: Spring is the most beautiful season of the year when flowers bloom.

definitions.text_mt: Spazju bejn tnejn għoljiet fejn jgħaddi l-ilma.

usage_examples.mt: Il-wied kien mimli ilma wara x-xita l-kbira.
usage_examples.en: The valley was full of water after heavy rain.
